items.title: Eurreal Wilford "Little Brother" Montgomery Interview, 1958-05-29
items.q: They had Hanson Sevier. He was a good piano player. He used to be piano player in the band.

ctx.x: Do you remember anybody else in that band? What?
The Bogalusa band? Oh yeah. They had Hanson Sevier. He was a good piano player. He used to be piano player in the band. Well some of the boys I just remember their names.
Yeah. Some of those fellas might still be up there though.
